description: Admin panel frontend screens for @terreno/api backends — part of Terreno, the batteries-included TypeScript framework for universal apps.
name: @terreno/admin-frontend

scripts.test: bun test --max-concurrency=1 && ROOT="$(pwd)" && for f in ./src/*.isolated.tsx ./src/*.isolated.ts ./src/isolated/*.isolated.tsx ./src/isolated/*.isolated.ts; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; if [ "$f" = "./src/isolated/hooks.isolated.tsx" ]; then (cd /tmp && bun test --preload "$ROOT/../ui/src/bunSetup.ts" --max-concurrency=1 "$ROOT/$f") || exit 1; else bun test --max-concurrency=1 ././"$f" || exit 1; fi; done
scripts.test:agent: ROOT="$(pwd)"; for f in ./src/*.test.ts ./src/*.test.tsx ./src/**/*.test.ts ./src/**/*.test.tsx ./src/isolated/*.isolated.tsx ./src/isolated/*.isolated.ts; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then if [ "$f" = "./src/isolated/hooks.isolated.tsx" ]; then (cd /tmp && AGENT=1 bun test --preload "$ROOT/../ui/src/bunSetup.ts" --only-failures "$ROOT/$f") || exit 1; else AGENT=1 bun test --only-failures "$f" || exit 1; fi; fi; done
